trickyParts: The fit check copies createAndFill's fill-before/match/fill-to-end, so a block Milkdown would complete by inserting required nodes (an ask holding only a list gets an empty paragraph) stays typed, exactly as Milkdown builds it.
A child Milkdown matches to no node, to a mark, or that cannot stand in as an empty node leaves the block as it was: the parser then throws (whole-body fallback) or builds it as before.
deviations: Default mode is unchanged: in the live editor and the document import a known block whose content breaks its rule (an ask holding a heading) still vanishes; the document service refuses such an ask with INVALID_ASK_BLOCK before it is stored. The architect asked to be told before default mode changes; it is not changed.
